question.text: An investor seeks tax efficiency on long-term equity gains. Under current Indian tax regime post Jul 2024:

answer.text: LTCG on equity is fully taxable
LTCG on equity above Rs. 1.25 lakh p.a. is taxed at 12.5%

explanation.text: The Logic: Post July 2024, LTCG on equity beyond Rs. 1.25 lakh/year attracts 12.5% tax. The Trap: Other options misstate rates. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule in X-B, XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Stagger exits across financial years to use annual exemption multiple times.
